document.abstract: In a recent Journal Paper,<sup>*</sup> Kolb) and Carr presented measurements of the flux vs frequeney on a number of 16mm magnetic-sound test films. In Sec. 6.2 of that paper, measurements by Morrison (STL) and an analysis by McKnight (Ampex) were also reported; these were preliminary measurements by STL which did not agree with those by Kolb and Carr, but were incorporated in the paper because of the pressure of the Journal publication schedule.
